notes.title: Sunny Trails - No time to loot
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!
Hope you had a great weekend!
[/p][p]We're very excited to announce that Sunny Trails is participating in the No Time To Loot event.[/p][p]There will be lots of cool games there, and I hope you enjoy them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080488/e41482e2643e3dee7cf11231022fb16542a84547.png"][/img]
If you are new here consider playing the demo and if you like it add Sunny Trails to your wishlist ❤️[/p][p align="start"]Thank you very much for your attention

[/p][p align="start"]Angela Vieira[/p][p align="start"]Plot Interactive[/p]

notes.title: New update: ORIGINAL VOICE!
notes.content:
[p]Hi! We hope you all are having a great day 
[/p][p]We updated the demo and now it has [b]ORIGINAL VOICE[/b]![/p][p]It's in Portuguese and English, with more languages ​​coming soon, stay tuned.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080488/1f0c2195d5c590dffdcc5e138504bc60dfa7be0a.png"][/img]
[/p][p]We also fixed some bugs that were in the game translations![/p][p]If you are enjoying Sunny Trails,  please consider leaving a review, that helps a lot ❤️[/p][p]Thank you very much for your attention

[/p][p]Angela Vieira[/p][p]Plot Interactive[/p]
